protocol.main_task: next observed event conditional on exactly twenty observed history events
protocol.observation_model: recorded coordinates; named jitter approximation for tied timestamps; no claim of exact latent event times
protocol.marks: unmarked main comparison, original mark indices retained in provenance
protocol.coordinate_measure: source time units times longitude-degree times latitude-degree; affine Jacobians restored once
protocol.spatial_boundary_policy: Declared closed preprocessing rectangle; retain observations on its outer boundary and assign them to the final spatial count cell. Temporal observation windows remain half-open.
protocol.uncertainty: paired seeds and circular moving blocks of seven observed calendar source records; synthetic independent windows use one-record blocks; dependence limitations reported
protocol.failure_policy: retain every planned cell; nonfinite/failed targets invalidate aggregate NLL and remain in failure ledger; never select test-best checkpoint

numerical_validation.acceptance: every checked validation target passes default-vs-refined NLL; no test-based refinement selection

count_forecast.horizon_policy: 20 times the train-fitted median positive raw inter-event interval, independent of coordinate normalization; synthetic identity transforms do not imply a whole-window forecast
count_forecast.origin_policy: event-triggered fixed horizon from the last of H observed events; fully observed coverage; no truth feedback
count_forecast.origin_selection: seeded random order over the fixed candidate sample; take the first fully observed origins, then restore chronological output order
count_forecast.scope: validated sampling routes only; unsupported models remain explicit unavailable cells

protocol.precision_policy: Raw statistical histories/targets use float64 source units; neural histories use existing strict float32 context conversion; source event IDs match exactly.
protocol.information_policy: Common H20 observed events and train-only fitted preprocessing. Seasonal Poisson additionally sees known calendar phase and is labelled a calendar-informed reference.

hpo.selection: minimum finite validation objective within family; trial0 wins ties; all trials must be attempted
hpo.statistical_selection: Model-specific explicit trials, same fixed validation targets; analytic/no-hyperparameter baselines have one trial, without duplicated learning-rate searches.

fit.validation_policy_rationale: A common 2048-target validation sample and 32-step cadence limit validation cost and permit early checkpoints within the fixed time budget. The subset is chosen once independently of model and seed.

compute.on_budget_exhaustion: stop launching; retain unrun cells; do not silently prune matrix

models.sampling_qualification: source Ogata time thinning with exact rectangle-truncated Gaussian spatial mixture; no finite MCMC
models.compute_rationale: Full-batch SciPy MLE uses four CPU threads and a declared two-hour ceiling to seek convergence, versus minibatch neural GPU training. Device-specific budgets and censored fits are reported; wall-clock caps are not equal-compute claims.
